svg.title: Survey layout at a site
svg.desc: Map of a site from above, with irregular kelp canopy polygons mapped across it. A plot about one tenth of the site is drawn tightly around the survey area. An inset shows the survey area from the side: plants rooted within it are counted, including plants below the surface, and plants rooted outside are not, even when their canopy drifts over.
svg.text: Side view of the survey area
